themes_detail.label: Dead Trees Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Dead or dying tree complaints spiked to 4 reports THIS WEEK, a 357% increase over the 8-week baseline average of 0.9 complaints per week, signaling a potential environmental or pest-driven tree die-off in Woodhaven/Richmond Hill requiring urgent public health investigation.
evidence: 4 dead/dying tree complaints filed THIS WEEK vs. 0.9 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (357% spike)
Z-score of 4.0 indicates statistically significant anomaly
Community Board budget requests include repeated requests for park improvements and tree-related amenities, suggesting baseline neglect
reporting_angles: Interview Parks Department about recent tree health assessments and whether a disease or pest outbreak is documented
Canvass affected blocks to photograph and geomap dead trees; compare to prior year's conditions

themes_detail.label: For-Hire Vehicle Surge
themes_detail.summary: For-hire vehicle complaints (Uber, Lyft, car services) exploded to 15 complaints 2 weeks ago, a 1100% spike over the 8-week baseline of 1.2 per week, suggesting emerging congestion, illegal parking, or safety issues related to ride-share activity in the district.
evidence: 15 for-hire vehicle complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 1.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (1100% increase)
Z-score of 12.62 indicates extreme statistical significance
Illegal parking remains top complaint category overall (4,820 complaints in 90 days), suggesting overlap with for-hire vehicle congestion
reporting_angles: Interview residents on streets with high for-hire complaints; document blocking of driveways and congestion patterns
Request TLC data on active for-hire licenses and trip volume changes in CD 409 over the past 2 months

themes_detail.label: Hazardous Materials Spike
themes_detail.summary: Hazardous materials complaints spiked to 3 reports last week, a 1100% increase over the 8-week baseline of 0.2 per week, indicating potential illegal dumping, chemical spills, or industrial violation surge requiring immediate environmental safety investigation.
evidence: 3 hazardous materials complaints last week vs. 0.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (1100% increase)
Z-score of 6.35 indicates highly significant anomaly
311 data does not specify nature of hazardous materials; requires verification on specific complaints
reporting_angles: File FOIL request for detail on the 3 hazardous materials complaints from last week: location, substance, source, enforcement action taken
Interview NYC Department of Environmental Protection and local residents near complaint addresses; assess whether industrial operations or dumping sites are involved

themes_detail.label: Food Establishment Violations
themes_detail.summary: Food establishment complaints surged to 7 reports last week, a 367% increase over the 8-week baseline of 1.5 per week, suggesting potential health code or sanitation violations at restaurants or food vendors warranting Health Department investigation.
evidence: 7 food establishment complaints last week vs. 1.5 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (367% increase)
Z-score of 11.0 indicates statistically significant spike
311 data does not specify complaint types (cleanliness, temperature, pest, labor); requires granular data review
reporting_angles: Contact NYC Department of Health to identify which establishments received complaints and what violations were cited
Interview residents about specific restaurants or food carts involved; assess whether there is a common issue (e.g., new vendor, construction, management change)

themes_detail.label: Litter Basket Shortfall
themes_detail.summary: Litter basket requests jumped to 3 complaints last week, a 243% increase over the 8-week baseline of 0.9 per week, suggesting residents perceive insufficient sanitation infrastructure and rising street cleanliness concerns in the district.
evidence: 3 litter basket requests last week vs. 0.9 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (243% increase)
Z-score of 6.43 indicates statistically significant spike
Dirty condition complaints also elevated 3 weeks ago (43 vs. 16.8 avg, 157% increase), suggesting interconnected sanitation challenges
reporting_angles: Canvass blocks with multiple litter basket requests; document visible litter and trash overflow
Contact Sanitation Department to review litter basket inventory and maintenance schedule for CD 409
